name: generic
description: Heuristic fallback. Infers amount column x-positions by clustering right-aligned numeric tokens. Always inspect profile_suggestion.json and the validation gate before trusting its output.
notes: Generic parsing is a starting point, not a guarantee. The validation gate will refuse to produce reports if the ledger does not close.
Prefer running profile_statements.py first, then copying its suggestion into a named profile and calibrating it against 3 sample PDFs from different years.
